Option B: Incremental Chunking & Ingestion
• Ingest NVD JSON to data/raw/nvd/
• Ingest KEV row to data/processed/kev.jsonl
• Incremental chunking into reference_chunks.jsonl
• Register in data/raw/web_ingested.json
• Hot-reload ReferenceRetriever index

div.style: color: rgb(70, 86, 108) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Execution budgets
One active Qwen request · worst case 10 Qwen calls
Up to 3 searches: initial query + two reviewer-driven refinements
At most one Critic-driven revision (revision analyst + critic re-review)
Up to 1,024 output tokens per call; 8,192 combined context/output

div.style: color: rgb(70, 86, 108) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Draft safety nets
Invalid parsed first drafts are kept (draft_invalid) and revised once
Deterministic evidence-only text only for unparseable or truncated output
or a revision that still fails deterministic validation
Trace: first_draft_invalid · draft_invalid_reason · draft_fallback_reason

div.style: color: rgb(70, 86, 108) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Frozen comparison · same gold SHA + evidence
Single: 80/80 · 300 calls · P95 15.368 s
Multi: 80/80 · 377 calls · P95 16.188 s
0 truncations; zero score lift from Critic
Pre-dates D16-D20; the D20 Analyst prompt change makes later runs not strictly comparable

div.style: color: rgb(70, 86, 108) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
